interpreted_intent: Stress-test the current fantasy visual semantics by rendering the agent-selected phoenix rebirth plus griffin pair in a complex photorealistic scene, using the attached portrait only as visible appearance guidance for an original adult fictional woman.
subject: One original adult fictional woman ash-ecology researcher, with visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair guided by the attached portrait, one reborn phoenix, and one separate complete griffin.
setting: A fire-scarred alpine sanctuary at dawn with an ash nest, broken stone roosts, and cold snow beyond the burn area.
event: The researcher records a phoenix emerging from its former ash state while a separate griffin braces at the sanctuary edge.
visual_priorities: Phoenix rebirth must show a former-state anchor, one renewed bird, a contiguous ash-to-feather transition, upward motion, and a localized material consequence.
The griffin must show one coherent body with eagle head and wings, avian forequarters, lion hindquarters and tail, and a readable anatomical junction; it must not resemble a hippogriff.
The attached portrait controls visible facial appearance, dark wavy hair, and restrained makeup balance only; the subject remains an original adult fictional woman.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy ash-ecology photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. At a fire-scarred alpine sanctuary at dawn, she shields a field camera while recording one phoenix rebirth from a collapsed ash nest. Keep the former charred feather husk and ash bed visible below one renewed bird; show a contiguous gradient from gray ash and ember fragments through glowing quills into intact red-gold feathers as the bird rises upward, lifting a localized plume and leaving a fresh scorch halo. On a separate broken stone roost, one complete griffin braces against the thermal gust with an eagle head and hooked beak, two feathered wings, avian chest and forelegs with talons, then one coherent anatomical junction into lion hindquarters and a lion tail. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a medium-wide dawn composition that keeps her face, ash-to-bird transition, former-state evidence, full griffin anatomy, and the creatures' spatial separation readable together.
